en.headline: Customs seize HK$100 million in suspected endangered species from containers
en.dek: Officers inspected four containers declared as seafood and bound for South Korea on 24 October, finding shark fins, skins and other regulated items.
body: Hong Kong Customs announced on Thursday that they had detected a suspected smuggling case involving an ocean-going vessel on 24 October. Large batches of suspected smuggled endangered species goods with an estimated market value of about HK$100 million were seized.

Through intelligence analysis and risk assessment, officers inspected four containers scheduled to be shipped to South Korea and declared as carrying seafood. Inside they found scheduled shark fins, shark skins, crocodile skins, seahorses, mobula ray gill plates and sea cucumbers, Customs said. The investigation is ongoing and the department does not rule out making arrests.

Smuggling of scheduled endangered species is a serious offence. Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, anyone who imports, exports or possesses specimens of endangered species not in accordance with the Ordinance commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a maximum fine of HK$10 million and imprisonment for 10 years.

Customs said it would continue to combat sea smuggling through risk management and intelligence-led strategies. Members of the public may report suspected smuggling activities to the department’s 24-hour hotline.

zh.headline: 海關破遠洋船走私案 檢獲約值一億元瀕危物種
zh.dek: 海關上月24日檢查四個原定運往韓國、報稱載有海鮮的貨櫃，檢獲受管制鯊魚翅、鱷魚皮、海馬等。
body: 香港海關周四宣布，於10月24日偵破一宗涉嫌利用遠洋船走私的案件，檢獲大批懷疑走私瀕危物種貨物，估計市值共約一億元。
海關透過情報分析及風險評估，檢查四個原定運往韓國、報稱載有海鮮的貨櫃。經查驗後發現受管制鯊魚翅、鯊魚皮、鱷魚皮、海馬、蝠鱝鰓板以及海參。案件仍在調查中，不排除會有人被捕。
走私受管制瀕危物種屬嚴重罪行。根據《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》，任何人如非按照條例規定進出口或管有瀕危物種均屬違法，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款一千萬元及監禁十年。
海關表示會繼續運用風險管理及情報主導策略打擊海上走私。市民如發現懷疑走私活動，可致電海關二十四小時熱線舉報。
